Description.description: The recorded outcome of a review. Preserves both the initial outcome captured at submission and the final outcome after remediation, recheck or regrade, so both survive under BR-007. A final outcome that differs from the initial is a reopen, override or regrade owned by the T&C Manager and requires a mandatory reason (OD-007, AD-031).
Whether the adviser is accountable for an Advice Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.

Whether the paraplanner is accountable for an Advice Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
Whether the paraplanner is accountable for an Advice Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
Whether the adviser is accountable for a File Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
Whether the adviser is accountable for a File Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
Whether the paraplanner is accountable for a File Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
Whether the paraplanner is accountable for a File Quality fail on this outcome. Set by the SetFailAccountability command (OD-024); read by the AD-039 export.
When the final outcome was set. Empty until the case outcome is finalised. Feeds remediation ageing MI under BR-010.

The outcome after remediation, recheck or regrade (BR-005). Empty until finalised. Held separately from the initial outcome so both survive under BR-007. A value that differs from the initial outcome is a regrade owned by the T&C Manager (OD-007, AD-031).
The outcome after remediation, recheck or regrade (BR-005), preserved separately from the initial outcome under BR-007.
The outcome recorded when the AQS review was submitted (BR-005). Immutable: a later correction is written to Final outcome, never here, so the initial outcome survives (BR-007).
The outcome recorded when the AQS review was submitted (BR-005), preserved under BR-007.
Short label identifying the outcome in lists.
The case this outcome belongs to. Restrict delete preserves the outcome record so both the initial and final outcome survive under BR-007 and BR-012.
Stable business code for the outcome. Alternate key, so re-issuing the same outcome upserts rather than duplicating under NFR-REL-01 (AD-014).
Unique identifier for the remediation action.
When a reopen, override or regrade set the final outcome (OD-007, AD-031). Empty when the final outcome equals the initial outcome.

The mandatory reason captured when the final outcome differs from the initial outcome, i.e. a reopen, override or regrade (OD-007, AD-031). The RegradeCase command enforces that this is non-empty and writes it to an immutable Audit Event (BR-012, NFR-AUD-01).
The review instance that produced this outcome, i.e. the AQS grade under BR-005. Restrict delete keeps the outcome traceable to the review that set it (BR-007, BR-012).
